item.title: One more dry day before on and off rounds of storms
item.description: March is starting off warm, but we are in store for some much needed rain coming later this week. --Nick Bannin

item.title: What we know about the West Sixth Street mass shooting gunman
item.description: According to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), Diagne entered the U.S. on a tourist visa in March 2000. Since then, he became a lawful permanent resident and gained citizenship.

item.title: Former Texas Tech student killed in Austin mass shooting
item.description: Ryder Harrington, a Texas Tech student, was one of two people killed in a shooting at a Sixth Street Austin bar that left 14 others injured, and a GoFundMe has been set up to support his loved ones.

item.title: Six Texas Congressional races to watch for on Tuesday
item.description: In the upcoming March primary, all 38 of Texas's Congressional seats are up for grabs, with many districts having 'non-traditional' races to watch, including two Democratic incumbents facing each other in TX-18 and a controversial Republican incumbent in TX-23

item.title: 3 killed, 14 injured in Sixth Street mass shooting, FBI says there are 'indicators' of terrorism
item.description: Three people are dead, including the shooter, and at least 14 others are injured after a gunman opened fire at a popular bar on West Sixth Street early Sunday morning.

item.title: 57 seconds: A look inside the police, EMS task force on scene at Austin's downtown mass shooting
item.description: In the aftermath of a devasting mass shooting on West Sixth Street in downtown Austin, city leaders echoed their thanks to a team of specialized officers and paramedics who arrived on scene to intervene and treat patients less than minute after shots rang out.

item.title: 'Tell your kids you love them.' Austin community honors victims killed in mass shooting — both young adults
item.description: The Austin Police Department on Monday identified the victims who were killed in Sunday's mass shooting on West Sixth Street — both young adults.

item.title: Austin Police name victims killed in West 6th Street mass shooting
item.description: Austin Police held a press conference Monday afternoon about the Sunday morning mass shooting on West Sixth Street that left three people dead, including the shooter, and 14 others injured.

item.title: Third victim dies after mass shooting in downtown Austin
item.description: A third victim has died after a mass shooting on Sunday morning that the FBI says is being investigated as a possible act of terrorism.

item.title: UT community remembers student killed in Sixth Street mass shooting
item.description: Savitha Shanmugasundaram was set to graduate from the University of Texas in May with dual degrees in Management Information Systems and Economics.
